questions.q: In a solution the quantity of common salt in 320 gm water is 31 gm. Calculate the concentration \% of the solution in context of mass by mass percentage.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, total mass $320+31 = 351$ gram hai. Ab 351 ka $10\%$ lagbhag $35.1$ hota hai. Apna solute sirf 31 gram hai, jo $35.1$ se thoda kam hai. Iska seedha matlab hai answer $10\%$ se thoda sa niche hoga. Options dekh, sirf ek hi value match kar rahi hai $8.83\%$. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Bina pen uthaye approximation maar. Seedha uda de! Mathematically :-
\frac{31}{351} \approx \frac{31}{350} \implies 9\% \text{ se thoda kam} \implies 8.83\% Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula lagana hai solute aur total solution ka. Mathematically :-
\frac{31}{31+320} \times 100 = \frac{31}{351} \times 100 \approx 8.831\% Exam Takeaway: CGL me exact division karke decimal me time waste nahi karna hai, denominator dekhte hi approximation lagana seekh aur option eliminate kar!
List IList II
Mass %$(\frac{\text{Solute}}{\text{Total Solution}}) \times 100$

questions.q: Population of a city X is 4,25,000. In the next three years, there is a total increase of $12\%$ in male population and increase of $20\%$ in female population, which results in male to female ratio as x:y. If the original male and female population of the city is 2,50,000 and 1,75,000 respectively, then find the value of (4x+5y).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Bhai zeros se dosti tod de. Original Male 250 aur Female 175 maan le. Zeros end me waise bhi ratio me kat jayenge. Male badh raha hai $12\%$ se aur female $20\%$ se. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha naya ratio likh aur equation me daal de! Mathematically :-
M_{new} = 250 \times 1.12 = 280
F_{new} = 175 \times 1.2 = 210
x:y = 280:210 = 4:3
4(4) + 5(3) = 16 + 15 = 31 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar proper zero ke sath solve karna hai toh ye kar par time jayega. Mathematically :-
M_{new} = 250000 \times 1.12 = 280000
F_{new} = 175000 \times 1.2 = 210000
x:y = 280000:210000 = 4:3 Exam Takeaway: Zeros ko dimaag me hi kaat dena chahiye ratio nikalte waqt, ye best time saver hai.
List IList II
Increase by R%Multiply by $(1 + \frac{R}{100})$

questions.q: An ore contains $25\%$ of an alloy that has $90\%$ iron. Other than this, in the remaining $75\%$ of the ore, there is no iron. How many kilograms of the ore are needed to obtain 60 kg of pure iron?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh, poore ore me loha kahan se aa raha hai? Sirf uss $25\%$ wale hisse se. Aur usme bhi pura loha nahi hai, uska bhi $90\%$ hai. Toh overall iron net percentage nikalo. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Overall iron nikal aur seedha $60$ se divide maar! Mathematically :-
\text{Net Iron} = 25\% \times 90\% = 22.5\%
X \times 22.5\% = 60
X = \frac{60}{0.225} = \frac{60000}{225} = 266.67 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Maan lo Total Ore $100x$ hai aur steps follow kar. Mathematically :-
\text{Alloy} = 25x
\text{Iron} = 90\% \times 25x = 22.5x
22.5x = 60 \implies x = \frac{60}{22.5}
100x = 100 \times \frac{60}{22.5} \approx 266.67 Exam Takeaway: Percentage of percentage ko hamesha multiply karke net percentage banaya kar, bahut time bachega.
List IList II
Net Iron %$25\% \times 90\% = 22.5\%$

questions.q: The price of petrol shot up by $5\%$. Before the hike, the price was $\text{Rs. } 82$ per litre. A man travels 3045 km every month and his car gives mileage of 15 km per litre. What is the increase the monthly expenditure (to the nearest Rs.) on the man's travel due to the hike in the petrol in prices?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Gadhe bachhe pura purana kharcha nikalenge aur naya kharcha nikal ke minus karenge. Apne ko smart banna hai! Sirf "increase" pucha hai, toh sirf "increased price" pe focus karenge. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Petrol ki extra keemat nikal aur total consumption se multiply kar de! Mathematically :-
\text{Extra Rate} = 82 \times 5\% = 4.1
\text{Total Litres} = \frac{3045}{15} = 203
\text{Extra Exp.} = 203 \times 4.1 = 832.3 \approx 832 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Old Exp aur New Exp nikal ke minus kar. Mathematically :-
\text{Old Exp} = 203 \times 82 = 16646
\text{New Exp} = 203 \times 86.1 = 17478.3
\text{Diff} = 17478.3 - 16646 = 832.3 Exam Takeaway: Humesha direct difference (delta) pe kaam kar, absolute values calculate karne me time kharab mat kar.
List IList II
Delta ExpenditureQuantity Consumed $\times$ Rate Increase

questions.q: Which of the following is the <u>least</u>? (CHSL TIER I-$\frac{13}{11}$/2025-SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Zeros ko udana seekh. Percentage ka $\frac{1}{100}$ do zeros ko kaat deta hai. Toh bas numbers ko multiply karna hai aur sabse chhota dhundhna hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Mental math laga aur values nikal ke compare maar. Mathematically :-
A: 2 \times 38 = 76
B: 25 \times 3 = 75
C: 18 \times 4.5 = 81
D: 3 \times 24 = 72 \text{ (Minimum)} Method 2 (Concept Builder): Likh ke zero kaatne wale lallu steps. Mathematically :-
\frac{30}{100} \times 240 = 3 \times 24 = 72 Exam Takeaway: Humesha $A\% \text{ of } B = B\% \text{ of } A$ aur zero-cancelling technique ka use kar.

questions.q: In an examination, (A + 6)% of the students failed in Mathematics and (A - 8)% failed in Science. $28\%$ of the students failed in both the subjects. If the percentage of students who passed in both the subjects was $50\%$, then what is the value of A?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Total bachhe 100% hote hain. Jo dono me pass hue wo $50\%$ hain, toh jo kisi na kisi me fail hue wo $100 - 50 = 50\%$ honge. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Universal rule laga aur equation solve kar! Mathematically :-
n(M \cup S) = n(M) + n(S) - n(M \cap S)
50 = (A + 6) + (A - 8) - 28
50 = 2A - 30 \implies 2A = 80 \implies A = 40 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Venn diagram ke logic se only math aur only science fail nikal ke total bana. Mathematically :-
\text{Only Math} = A + 6 - 28 = A - 22
\text{Only Sci} = A - 8 - 28 = A - 36
\text{Total Fail} = (A - 22) + (A - 36) + 28 = 2A - 30
2A - 30 = 50 \implies A = 40 Exam Takeaway: Venn diagram draw karne me time kharab mat kar, seedha $A \cup B$ wala equation dimag me set rakh.
List IList II
Total Union$n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$

questions.q: A stock portfolio consists of four stocks. Stock A represents $10\%$ of the portfolio and has a return of $4\%$. Stock B represents $20\%$ of the portfolio and has a return of $8\%$. Stock C represents $30\%$ of the portfolio and has a return of $3\%$. Stock D represents the remaining $40\%$ of the portfolio and has a <u>negative-return</u> of $6\%$. What is the average return of the portfolio?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM/Deviation Pen-Free Observation: Yahan seedha portfolio ke weights ko returns se multiply karna hai. Positive returns add honge aur negative wala subtract hoga. Base hamesha total weight $100\%$ rahega. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Values ko direct multiply karke add maar de aur 100 se divide kar! Mathematically :-
10(4) + 20(8) + 30(3) + 40(-6) = 40 + 160 + 90 - 240 = 50
\text{Avg Return} = \frac{50}{100} = 0.5\% Method 2 (Concept Builder): Weighted average ka proper formula laga. Mathematically :-
\frac{w_1r_1 + w_2r_2 + w_3r_3 + w_4r_4}{w_1+w_2+w_3+w_4} = \frac{40+160+90-240}{100} = 0.5\% Exam Takeaway: Weighted average ke questions me negative values pe dhyan dena, silly mistake se bacha layega.
List IList II
Weighted Sum$\Sigma (Weight \times Return) / \Sigma Weight$

questions.q: If $65\%$ of 350 - ?% of 250 + $40\%$ of 120 = 158, then find the value of ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Equation ko seedha simplify kar. $40\%$ of 120 toh lallu hai, seedha 48. $65\%$ of 350 thoda calculative hai par isko decimal $0.65 \times 350$ likh sakte hain. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Decimal hatake direct equation solve maar! Mathematically :-
350 \times 0.65 = 227.5
48 - 2.5x + 227.5 = 158
275.5 - 2.5x = 158 \implies 2.5x = 117.5
25x = 1175 \implies x = 47 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Digital Sum (C9) se option verify kar le jaldi se. Mathematically :-
65\%(DS=2) \times 350(DS=8) \rightarrow 16 \rightarrow 7
40\%(DS=4) \times 120(DS=3) \rightarrow 12 \rightarrow 3
158(DS=5)
7 - 7x + 3 = 5 \implies 10 - 7x = 5 \implies 7x = 5 \implies 7(2) = 14 \rightarrow 5 \implies x=47 Exam Takeaway: Digital sum wahan lagao jahan normal calculation time le rahi ho.

Digital Sum (C9)Match DS of LHS and RHS options

questions.q: If the first number is $15\%$ less than the third number and the ratio of the second and third numbers is 3: 5, then by what percentage is the average of the first and third numbers more than the second number?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method Pen-Free Observation: Sabse best tareeqa hai Third number ko 100 maan lena. Isse calculations ekdum butter ho jayengi. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Base ko 100 maan aur direct ratio shift maar! Mathematically :-
T = 100 \implies F = 85
S:T = 3:5 \implies 5u = 100 \implies 1u = 20 \implies S = 60
\text{Avg}(F,T) = \frac{85+100}{2} = 92.5
\text{Req } \% = \frac{92.5-60}{60} \times 100 = \frac{32.5}{60} \times 100 = 54.16\% Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables me khel ke equation bana par time katega. Mathematically :-
z = x, y = 0.85x, y:z = 3:5 \dots Exam Takeaway: Jab bhi percentages aur ratios mixed aayein, common element ko 100 ka multiple maano.
List IList II
Base Shift RuleMake Third Number = 100

questions.q: A solution of sugar and milk contains $26\%$ sugar by weight. After boiling, 63 kg milk evaporates and the solution now contains $40\%$ of sugar. Find the original quantity of solution?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio) Pen-Free Observation: Boil karne par pani ya doodh udata hai, cheeni wahi rehti hai. Solid part humesha constant rahega. Bas yahi equation banani hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Solid part equate kar aur ratio nikal le! Mathematically :-
26\% \times O = 40\% \times N
O:N = 40:26 = 20:13
\text{Evaporated} = 7u = 63 \implies 1u = 9
\text{Original} = 20u = 20 \times 9 = 180 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equation me quantity ko $x$ maan ke solve kar. Mathematically :-
0.26x = 0.40(x - 63)
0.26x = 0.40x - 25.2 \implies 0.14x = 25.2 \implies x = 180 Exam Takeaway: Mixture me jo cheez evaporate/add nahi hoti, hamesha usi ko equate kiya kar!
List IList II
Solid Constancy$P_1 \times Q_1 = P_2 \times Q_2$

questions.q: In Veeru Bhai Pvt. limited company $60\%$ of the employees are men and $48\%$ of the employees are engineers and $66.66\%$ of these are men. The percentage of women who are <u>not</u> engineers:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Jab percentage of percentages khela ja raha ho, total employees ko 100 maan lo. Language ki trap pakadni hai, poocha kiske reference me hai ye dekhna zaroori hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total 100 leke branches bana! Mathematically :-
\text{Total} = 100, \text{W} = 40
\text{Engg} = 48, \text{M.Engg} = \frac{2}{3} \times 48 = 32
\text{F.Engg} = 48 - 32 = 16
\text{Non-Engg W} = 40 - 16 = 24
\text{Req } \% = \frac{24}{40} \times 100 = 60\% Method 2 (Concept Builder): Galti se total se divide mat karna. Language pe dhyan dena. Mathematically :-
\text{Base} = 40 \implies \frac{24}{40} \times 100 = 60\% Exam Takeaway: Percentage kiske "respect" me pucha hai (Base), usko hamesha underline kar!
List IList II
Language TrapDenominator is Total Women

questions.q: A milkman bought 50 litres of milk for $\text{Rs. } 2000$. 5 litres spoiled. At what rate per litre should he sell the remaining milk to make a profit of $20\%$ on his total outlay?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Milkman ko sirf apne total kharche pe $20\%$ profit nikalna hai. Use ghanta farq padta hai kitna doodh fuk gaya, bas vasooli bache doodh se karni hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total revenue target nikal aur bachi quantity se divide kar de! Mathematically :-
\text{Target} = 2000 \times 1.2 = 2400
\text{Left Qty} = 50 - 5 = 45
\text{Rate} = \frac{2400}{45} = 53.33 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Per unit cost nikal ke complicate mat kar. Mathematically :-
\text{CP/L} = 40 \implies \text{Logic fails here without total target} Exam Takeaway: Target total revenue nikal aur divided by remaining quantity kar de. Best hack!

New SPTarget Total Revenue / Remaining Qty

questions.q: In a speed test a student got $30\%$ marks and failed by 25 marks. In the same speed test another student got $40\%$ marks and secured $25\%$ marks more than the essential minimum marks. Then max. marks set for speed test?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM/Deviation Pen-Free Observation: Do situations di hain, dono ko Passing Marks (PM) ke reference me equate karna hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Passing marks ko base banakar equate maar de! Mathematically :-
PM_1 = 30\% + 25
1.25 \times PM_2 = 40\% \implies PM_2 = 32\%
30\% + 25 = 32\% \implies 2\% = 25
100\% = 25 \times 50 = 1250 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic variable equation solve kar. Mathematically :-
0.4M = 1.25(0.3M + 25) \implies 0.4M = 0.375M + 31.25 \implies M = 1250 Exam Takeaway: Pass/Fail marks ko ek single reference variable pe le aao aur equation equate kardo.
List IList II
Find common anchor$PM_1 = PM_2$

questions.q: For a number, greater than one, the difference between itself and its reciprocal is $20\%$ of the sum of itself and its reciprocal. By how much percentage (nearest to an integer) is the square of the number less than its cube?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Equation frame karo aur cross multiply se seedha square nikal lo. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Equation ko solve karke cube aur square ka ratio nikal! Mathematically :-
x - \frac{1}{x} = 0.2(x + \frac{1}{x}) \implies \frac{x - 1/x}{x + 1/x} = \frac{1}{5}
5x - \frac{5}{x} = x + \frac{1}{x} \implies 4x = \frac{6}{x} \implies x^2 = 1.5
x = \sqrt{1.5} \approx 1.224
\text{Req } \% = \frac{x^3 - x^2}{x^3} \times 100 = (1 - \frac{1}{x}) \times 100
(1 - \frac{1}{1.224}) \times 100 \approx (1 - 0.817) \times 100 \approx 18.3\% \approx 18\% Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute values pe jayega toh decimals me fasega, seedha ratio pakad. Mathematically :-
\text{Req } \% = \frac{A-B}{A} \times 100 = (1 - \frac{B}{A}) \times 100 Exam Takeaway: Percentage less/more pooche algebra me toh hamesha unka ratio $\frac{A}{B}$ le lo, absolute values nikalne ki zaroorat nahi hoti.
List IList II
% Less of A wrt B$(1 - \frac{A}{B}) \times 100$

questions.q: If decreasing 120 by x% gives the same result as increasing 40 by x% then x% of 720 is what percentage more than (x+15)% of 200? (Round off to the nearest integer)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: 120 ko ghata rahe ho aur 40 ko badha rahe ho to same result aa raha hai. Ratio nikal ke $x$ seedha pata chal sakta hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Equation banake $x$ uda aur gap percent nikal! Mathematically :-
120(1 - \frac{x}{100}) = 40(1 + \frac{x}{100}) \implies 3(100 - x) = 100 + x
300 - 3x = 100 + x \implies 4x = 200 \implies x = 50
\text{P1} = 50\% \times 720 = 360
\text{P2} = 65\% \times 200 = 130
\text{Req } \% = \frac{360 - 130}{130} \times 100 = \frac{230}{130} \times 100 \approx 177\% Method 2 (Concept Builder): Percentages ko fraction me likh. Mathematically :-
120(1 - x) = 40(1 + x) \dots Exam Takeaway: Is tarah ke 2-step problems mains me bahut aate hain. Jaldi $x$ nikal ke second statement me ghuso.
List IList II
Percentage Gap$\frac{\text{Diff}}{\text{Base}} \times 100$

questions.q: The total cost of 5 pens and 3 notebooks is 130. If the cost of pen is decreased by $25\%$ and that of the notebook is increased by $10\%$ then total cost of 3 pens and 2 notebooks will be 67. what is the total original cost (in) of 6 pens and 4 notebook?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Equations direct frames kar aur fraction ya decimal se dosti rakh! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Equation likh, decimal hata aur seedha eliminate maar! Mathematically :-
5P + 3N = 130
3(0.75P) + 2(1.1N) = 67 \implies 2.25P + 2.2N = 67
\text{Multiply by 20: } 45P + 44N = 1340
\text{Multiply Eq1 by 9: } 45P + 27N = 1170
17N = 170 \implies N = 10 \implies 5P = 100 \implies P = 20
6P + 4N = 6(20) + 4(10) = 160 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables leke normal elimination kar, bas decimal avoid kar. Mathematically :-
2.25P + 2.2N = 67 \times 100 = 225P + 220N = 6700 Exam Takeaway: Decimal equations ko 10 ya 100 se multiply karke whole numbers me le aao, calculation mistakes nahi hongi.
List IList II
Avoid float mathMultiply equation to remove decimals

questions.q: A man started off a business with a certain capital amount. In the first year, he earned $40\%$ profit and donated $14.28\%$ of the total capital (initial amount + profit). He followed the same procedure with the remaining capital after the second and the third year. If at the end of the three years, he is left with 4320, what was the initial amount with which the man started his business?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Bhai jab bhi same procedure repeat ho raha ho, seedha compounding lagta hai multiplier banake. $14.28\%$ ko turant $\frac{1}{7}$ soch lena chahiye. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ek saal ka net multiplier bana aur power 3 laga de! Mathematically :-
\text{Mult}_1 = 1.4
\text{Mult}_2 = 1 - \frac{1}{7} = \frac{6}{7}
\text{Net Mult} = 1.4 \times \frac{6}{7} = 1.2
C \times (1.2)^3 = 4320
C \times 1.728 = 4320 \implies C = \frac{4320}{1.728} = 2500 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Har saal alag alag calculate karega toh zindagi nikal jayegi. Mathematically :-
C \rightarrow 1.4C \rightarrow 1.4C - \frac{1.4C}{7} \dots Exam Takeaway: Successive increase/decrease me fraction multiplier banake power me dal diya karo.
List IList II
Repeated Process$Final = Initial \times (m)^n$

questions.q: Suresh decides to donate $46.67\%$ of his monthly salary but later he donates 4900 which is $22.22\%$ less than the amount he planned to donate earlier then find the monthly income of Suresh.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Ye ajeeb se percentages dekh ke ghapla nahi karna, inko standard fractions me todo. $46.67\%$ ko $40\% + 6.67\%$ dekhna shuru kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Fractions break kar aur seedha answer nikal! Mathematically :-
46.67\% = \frac{2}{5} + \frac{1}{15} = \frac{7}{15}
22.22\% \text{ less} = 1 - \frac{2}{9} = \frac{7}{9}
\text{Income} \times \frac{7}{15} \times \frac{7}{9} = 4900
\text{Income} = \frac{4900 \times 15 \times 9}{49} = 13500 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable $x$ leke pure decimal me khelega toh doobega. Mathematically :-
0.4667x \times (1 - 0.2222) = 4900 \dots Exam Takeaway: Non-standard percentages ko hamesha base standard percentages me tod kar fraction banaya kar.
List IList II
46.67%$\frac{7}{15}$

questions.q: A stationary supplier ordered 8 boxes of premium pens and some boxes of standard pens. The price of premium pens per box was twice that of standard pens. When the order was delivered, the number of boxes of premium and standard pens had been accidentally interchanged. This increased the total bill by $25\%$. What was the ratio of the original number of premium pens to the original number of boxes of standard pens? (CGL TIER I- $\frac{13}{09}$/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method Pen-Free Observation: Price ka ratio P:S = 2:1 hai. Quantity P=8 aur S=x. Interchange hone pe bill $25\%$ badha. Options ka sahara sabse badhiya hoga yaha. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Equation likh aur jaldi se solve maar! Mathematically :-
\text{Orig} = 8(2) + x(1) = 16 + x
\text{New} = x(2) + 8(1) = 2x + 8
1.25(16 + x) = 2x + 8 \implies \frac{5}{4}(16 + x) = 2x + 8
80 + 5x = 8x + 32 \implies 3x = 48 \implies x = 16
\text{Ratio } P:S = 8:16 = 1:2 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Seedha options plug kar, 15 second bachenge. Mathematically :-
\text{Try 1:2 } \implies x = 16
\text{Orig} = 16+16=32, \text{New} = 32+8=40
\text{Inc} = \frac{8}{32} = 25\% \text{ (Matched)} Exam Takeaway: Interchange wale questions me options plug karna sabse khatarnak shortcut hota hai.
List IList II
Option PluggingCheck which ratio gives 25% increase
